# PDFCraft

> Free browser-based PDF toolkit: merge, split, compress, convert, rotate, protect and watermark PDF files. Processing happens on the user's device — files are not uploaded to a server.

## What this site is

PDFCraft (pdf.craftisle.com) is a PDF utility suite. Every tool runs in the browser, so a file stays on the user's machine. The interface is localised (English is the default locale at `/en`).

## Tools (134 total, sample)

- [pdf-multi-tool](https://pdf.craftisle.com/en/tools/pdf-multi-tool): Multi-tool workbench for PDF operations
- [merge-pdf](https://pdf.craftisle.com/en/tools/merge-pdf): Merge PDF files into one document
- [split-pdf](https://pdf.craftisle.com/en/tools/split-pdf): Split a PDF into separate files or page ranges
- [compress-pdf](https://pdf.craftisle.com/en/tools/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file size
- [edit-pdf](https://pdf.craftisle.com/en/tools/edit-pdf): Edit PDF content in the browser
- [jpg-to-pdf](https://pdf.craftisle.com/en/tools/jpg-to-pdf): Convert images to PDF
- [sign-pdf](https://pdf.craftisle.com/en/tools/sign-pdf)
- [crop-pdf](https://pdf.craftisle.com/en/tools/crop-pdf)

- [page-numbers](https://pdf.craftisle.com/en/tools/page-numbers)
- [add-watermark](https://pdf.craftisle.com/en/tools/add-watermark): Stamp a text or image watermark on a PDF

## URL pattern

- `https://pdf.craftisle.com/en/tools/{slug}` — one page per tool
- `https://pdf.craftisle.com/{locale}/tools/{slug}` — localised versions (e.g. `/ja`, `/de`, `/fr`)
- Sitemap: https://pdf.craftisle.com/sitemap.xml

## Citing

`PDFCraft, https://pdf.craftisle.com/`
